scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @uno/server" "npm run dev -w @uno/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @uno/client && npm run build -w @uno/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit
